mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation (u_id, treatment_id, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uId}, #{treatmentId}, #{consultationMemo}, #{preferredDate}, #{preferredTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT consultation_id, u_id, reservation_id, treatment_id, admin_id, consultation_status, consultation_memo, preferred_date, preferred_time, created_at, updated_at FROM consultation WHERE u_id = #{uId} ORDER BY consultation_id
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation SET treatment_id = #{treatmentId}, consultation_memo = #{consultationMemo}, preferred_date = #{preferredDate}, preferred_time = #{preferredTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId} AND u_id = #{uId}
UPDATE consultation SET consultation_status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId} AND u_id = #{uId}
